description: Adversarial taxonomic histories reconstructed from the real corpus. 'states' pins the corpus state at the end of a year (null = not yet proposed); 'published_as' pins literal names the corpus used by that year. See docs/audit/scientific-model-audit.md for the narrative of each case.

cases.why: Species concept renamed three times; genus disputed as juvenile Tyrannosaurus; argued sinking (2020) and argued revival (2025).
Riggs (1903) sinks it without recorded evidence, but the corpus keeps treating it as valid; argued revival 2015, disputed again 2016.
An inverted hypothesis (Torosaurus = mature Triceratops): proposed, challenged and defended in successive years; no single refutation.
Ontogenetic synonymy with Pachycephalosaurus argued twice; papers keep using Stygimoloch as valid afterwards.
A non-dinosaur hypothesis about phylogenetic placement; sunk by an abstract-level (unverified) direct reading.
Control: a stable taxon must stay in use with no turning point after its first.
